samples.summary: New `login --allow-unbound-callback` flag is not in the agent-facing command schema registry
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/schema/registry.ts:43-50 declares the `login` schema with `parameters: { '--server': ... }` only. The diff adds a real, security-relevant option to the same command (`packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts`, `.option('--allow-unbound-callback', ...)`), so `wafflebase schema login` — the machine-readable surface agents read to discover flags — now under-reports the command. `packages/cli/test/schema.test.ts` only checks the entry exists, so nothing fails; the registry is a hand-maintained mirror of commander and this consumer was not updated.

samples.summary: New `undici` dependency raises the CLI's real Node floor above its declared `engines`
samples.evidence: packages/cli/package.json:11 still declares `"node": ">=20"`, but the added dependency resolves to undici@7.29.0, whose own engines field is `{node: '>=20.18.1'}` (pnpm-lock.yaml:9029). `@wafflebase/cli` is published to npm, so users on Node 20.0–20.18.0 now get an EBADENGINE warning and an unsupported transport at runtime for every export path (`packages/cli/src/docs/image-fetcher.ts` imports undici at module load, which `packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts:10` and `packages/cli/src/commands/slides.ts:13` pull in). tsup externalizes third-party deps (packages/cli/tsup.config.ts:15), so undici is installed, not bundled.

samples.summary: Existing export consumers now fail for internal image hosts that are not exactly the configured server origin/port
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/slides.ts:214 and packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts:273 build the fetcher with only `serverBase`; the new gate in packages/cli/src/docs/image-fetcher.ts exempts an internal address only when the URL's effective port equals the configured server's port. Any self-hosted or dev document whose image `src` was persisted against a different internal host/port (a LAN object store, a proxy, or an older deployment that served images on another port) now makes `docs export`/`slides export` fail where it previously succeeded. I could not find such a persisted URL shape in-tree (frontend persists `VITE_BACKEND_API_URL`-based absolutes, packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/image-upload.ts:3,86; backend returns `/api/v1/.../images/<id>`, packages/backend/src/miro/miro.service.ts:451), so this is a suspicion about deployments rather than a confirmed in-repo caller.
